# STARSHIP ENCOUNTER - Edward Perati - DREAMER 13 pp.13-14 (PDF pp.15-16)
# load 0080-03FF (printed 0200-03FF on p.13, 0080-00FF on p.14; 0100-01FF is display RAM); run C000 FN 3
# how to play: press E to start: the Starship (centre) and your Fighter (top left) appear, three
# bleeps, then the enemy (X) appears and wanders randomly. Fighter: 8 left, A right, 5 up, D down,
# F fire laser (horizontal only, in the direction the Fighter faces). E energises the Starship's
# force field (expanding boxes) to destroy an enemy near it. After a collision the score is shown
# (fighters left, enemy hit), three bleeps, play resumes. Start with 10 fighters; 20 enemy hit =
# a new game keeping the remaining fighters; at 0 fighters the score stays on screen, E restarts.
# Key locations (article): E 0245, F 0247, 8 0249, A 024B, 5 024D, D 024F.
# Reading notes: in the scan the key digits at 0248-024E are partly overwritten by hand-written
# marks of a reader; read as 6708 680A 6905 6E0D, as the article's key table requires. 0202 looks
# like E69E (a mark over the 5): E59E, the wait for key E (V5 = 0E at 0200), as the article says.
# 00C0 row is faint: 0808 words follow the force-field sprite (F8 08..08 F8, 11 rows).
